headline: UFP Industries (UFPI) Surpasses Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: UFP Industries (UFPI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.78% and +3.99%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
